finding.claim: Unauthenticated /preview endpoint fetches an arbitrary attacker-supplied URL server-side and reflects status and first 500 chars of the body back to the caller.

trace.note: requests.get(target) — no scheme, host, or IP-range validation; redirects followed by default
returns resp.status_code and resp.text[:500] as JSON — response reflected to caller

finding.guards_checked: None on the path: no scheme allowlist, no host allowlist, no private/link-local IP block, no redirect re-validation, no auth. Full-read SSRF.

verdict.guard_found: none. app.py:13-17 has no auth decorator, scheme, host, or IP check; the only host check (app.py:23-24, ALLOWED_HOSTS) is in the separate /partner handler and does not cover /preview.
verdict.reason: The /preview handler at app.py:13-17 takes the unauthenticated `url` query parameter (app.py:15), passes it straight to requests.get with default redirect following (app.py:16), and returns the status code and first 500 characters of the body (app.py:17), so the claimed full-read SSRF holds.

finding.claim: /partner host allowlist is checked only on the initial URL; requests follows redirects by default, so an allowed partner host that redirects to an internal address bypasses the allowlist (blind SSRF with status-code oracle).

trace.note: if host not in ALLOWED_HOSTS (app.py:9: api.partner.example, cdn.partner.example) → 400 — enforced on initial URL only
requests.get(target) with default allow_redirects=True; a 3xx from an allowed host is followed to any address
returns only resp.status_code — blind, status-code oracle

finding.guards_checked: Hostname allowlist at app.py:24 is enforced (string equality on urlparse hostname) but applies only to the first request. No redirect re-check, no allow_redirects=False, no IP-range block. Exploitability requires an open redirect or attacker-influenced response on an allowed partner host; not verified in this repo. Unverified: whether urlparse and urllib3 disagree on host parsing (userinfo/backslash variants) — not reported.

verdict.guard_found: Exact hostname set membership on the parsed initial URL at app.py:23-24 (urlparse(target).hostname not in ALLOWED_HOSTS, returns 400). It is not applied to redirect hops, and requests.get at app.py:26 has no allow_redirects=False and no per-hop re-check.
verdict.reason: The trace is accurate: app.py:22 takes url from an unauthenticated query parameter and app.py:26 calls requests.get(target) with default redirect following, so the exact-match allowlist at app.py:24 covers only the first hop. Whether this becomes exploitable depends on an allowed partner host (api.partner.example or cdn.partner.example) returning a redirect to an internal address, which is not visible in this repo, so the verdict cannot be settled from the code.
